name: Django monolith
summary: One Django project with server-rendered pages (htmx for interaction), the admin for back-office work, Postgres, and Celery for background jobs. The fastest route to a data-heavy product for a Python team.

fitsWhen.says: a web product with forms and back-office work

avoidWhen.says: it needs a rich offline or mobile client

frontend.why: Server-rendered templates with htmx keep one codebase; add React for the one screen that needs it.

backend.why: ORM, migrations, admin, auth and forms included; the admin covers back-office screens on day one.

queue.why: Emails, imports and scheduled jobs (celery beat).

auth.why: Built on Django's own auth; social logins and email verification.

infra.why: Web, worker, beat, Postgres and Redis on one host.

ci-cd.why: Tests and migrations check on every pull request.

hosting.why: Web + worker + Postgres without a cluster.

services.name: web
responsibilities: Domain logic in the apps' services

environments.name: dev
environments.hosting: docker compose: web (runserver), worker, beat, Postgres, Redis

environments.name: staging
environments.purpose: A copy of production for checking a release

environments.name: prod
environments.hosting: Render services with managed Postgres, daily backups

stages.name: deploy
stages.does: main to staging, tags to prod; migrate as a release step

notes: Static files served by WhiteNoise or a CDN

security.auth: Django sessions with CSRF protection on every form
notes: Validate every input at the API boundary and return typed errors, never stack traces.
Parameterised queries only (the ORM), so no SQL is built from strings.
Set secure, HttpOnly, SameSite cookies or short-lived tokens; rate-limit sign-in.
Check authorisation on every endpoint on the server, not only in the UI (OWASP A01 Broken Access Control).

folderLayout:

  settings/
    base.py
    dev.py
    prod.py
  urls.py

apps/

pyproject.toml
conventions: One Django app per domain area
Business rules in services.py, not in views or models' save()
Templates render partials that htmx swaps

adrs.title: A monolith first
adrs.decision: One Django project holds every feature.
adrs.why: A small team moves fastest with one deploy and one database; boundaries are kept as Django apps.

adrs.title: Server-rendered UI
adrs.decision: Templates with htmx instead of a SPA.
adrs.why: No separate front-end build or API contract to keep in step.

repos.label: app
repos.layout: A Django project with config/ and apps/

files.template: What it is, how to run it with docker compose, and the management commands.
Django 5, psycopg, celery, redis, django-allauth, gunicorn, whitenoise; dev: pytest-django, ruff.
Settings read from the environment: DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL, SECRET_KEY, allowed hosts; installed apps include allauth and apps.core.
A home view and a health view that checks the database.
ruff, makemigrations --check and pytest against Postgres.
